project.title: aquascape-solids-fronts-v5
project.description: Twenty-asset scenery expansion using independently generated full-resolution cameras. Reuse accepted four existing assets. Code automation reduces repeated Codex work in 3D construction, not artwork detail.
project.art_direction: Match the supplied approved aquarium pixel illustration finish: fine deliberate crisp pixel clusters, broad coherent painted color masses, natural material planes, subtle detailed highlights and restrained color. No smooth CGI, no photo noise, no uniform speckling. Isolated on pure white, no floor, water, cast shadow or scenery. No labels, panels, collage, text or extra views. One complete object fills most of this image with clean margins. Keep source resolution: this is one full-resolution artwork, not a multi-view sheet.
project.gameplay_loop: Inspect twenty scenery assets in a native Godot catalogue, including ten animated plant species.
project.session_goal: Distinct source-matched generated props and plant anatomy with explicit species and independent views.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1536x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: twisted_branch_front
asset.description:
Create the definitive FRONT artwork of this NEW aquarium scenery design: One long low S-curved driftwood limb with a thick twisted knot near the left third and one short blunt side spur. Flattened worn contact underside, irregular broken ends with visible fibers, flowing grain spirals through the knot. Muted gray-brown with pale weathered ridges. Length 46 cm, height 15 cm, depth 18 cm. No extra upright branches, no uniform cylindrical log, no leaves or holes.
Match the supplied approved aquarium pixel illustration finish: fine deliberate crisp pixel clusters, broad coherent painted color masses, natural material planes, subtle detailed highlights and restrained color. No smooth CGI, no photo noise, no uniform speckling. Isolated on pure white, no floor, water, cast shadow or scenery. No labels, panels, collage, text or extra views. One complete object fills most of this image with clean margins. Keep source resolution: this is one full-resolution artwork, not a multi-view sheet.
Camera: strict orthographic FRONT ELEVATION from +Z toward -Z, eye exactly level at the object's center. X is horizontal, Y vertical. No visible area of horizontal top planes from camera tilt; do not use a three-quarter/isometric camera. Preserve believable painted 3D volume and material.
The reference determines pixel drawing finish only; do not copy the reference species or existing prop design. Entire plant root crown/root tips or whole stone/wood base and all extremities must be visible. For a plant, show natural three-dimensional leaf arrangement, distinct leaf identities, anatomically correct base, no pot/soil/rock/wood. For wood, continuous grain through every fork and natural irregular blunt broken ends; no geometric tubes or spikes. One complete illustration, no auxiliary objects.
